headline: PHI @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 5.78 at WSN 4.70, with a projected total of 10.48. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +0.90 runs while WSN moved +0.36, changing the projected margin by +0.53 runs. The projected total climbed +1.26, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Miles Mikolas has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nasim Nuñez, Dylan Crews, CJ Abrams, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
